rule: NES: 1 backdrop shared by both layers, 4 background palettes of 3 entries on 16x16 areas, 4 sprite palettes of 3 entries plus transparency on 8x8 tiles; every entry is a data/nes_palette.json entry number
notes: written by tools/art/make_battle_bg.py for the BG-BATTLE card (t_1c5a8599); no scene_battle_*.json existed before this card, so this file defines the set in the format scene_ship.json uses
backdrop $0F black is the shared backdrop of all four battle strips
background palettes cover the 16x7 attribute cells of the strip, one palette per cell
grey steel bulkheads with a rivet seam, a pipe run under the deckhead, a red access hatch
bg0 the bulkhead plate and the deckhead, bg1 the deck floor grating, bg2 the hatch, bg3 the pipes
the hatch is a 32x48 block, so its cells are quadrants of one shape rather than four shapes
sprite palettes are declared for the battle cast the scene draws; the strip itself draws no sprites

judged.exempt: a contact sheet is a diagnostic, not a cast: it draws the whole v2 roster in one image, so no single palette set can carry it and a cast check on it would say nothing. It is also a BY PRODUCT: output/sprites_v2_sheet.png is gitignored, so no clean checkout reproduces it, and two generators write different content under the one name (tools/art/make_characters_v2.py measures 11 records on this machine, tools/art/make_title_rows_v2.py 3 on the far side). Card t_c93a983f, ruling section 8 of knowledge/PALETTE-RULINGS-2026-10-25.md: when the file is absent the row reports NOT MEASURED with a printed line instead of refusing the run, and when it is present it is measured and reported advisory whatever it measures
